items.reason: Facts this area shows: unread help replies (red dot, spoken label, New tags, phone pop-up), the MettleUp Plus line (plan end, free month), workout counts (erase, load demo, restore questions), weekly goal line. None of them is gym-register data shown elsewhere in the panel, HQ or exports: help replies live in the HQ help store, and the Plus line (the only gym plan-end fact) is behind the plan switch, so a store build says 'Every feature is free'. No Crispy Curves comparison possible for a switched-off line; all places of each fact read one shared rule.
No difference found: the dot and the New tags use the same 'reply newer than last seen' rule; the pop-up shows no number; Settings and the Plus screen share one line maker.

Date numbers traced: free month days left (day 1, last day, clock set back), gym plan end with 7 grace days, a renewal that starts later after a gap (counts as open, by the stated rule), reply time order with a missing time (1970 stand-in). Server writes every reply time as ISO, so the text compare is safe.
No number wrong at an edge: last day reads 'ends today', the day before reads 2 days in both the Settings line and the warning pop-up.

Summary numbers with rows: the red dot over the conversation list, and the fold heading count (FoldedList passes items.length; the finished-workout Exercises count is the same list's length). The dot dropping after a visit is the expected 'read' state.
No summary differs from its rows. The one undeclared drop already on file is a restore that leaves out damaged workouts (FN-B-truth-phone-components-2-a-01).
Opened the files that work numbers out: help history logic, member plan rules, plan words, restore impact, backup store, history export and data actions counts.

Dot number: unreadReplies over unreadOf; each row's New tag: conversationOf with the seen time taken when the screen opened. Workout counts: three makers (all sessions on the hidden Android backup card and the Drive restore question; own workouts without demo on erase, load demo and file restore; workouts with sets in the spreadsheet), each matching what its own line claims.

Long-gap case: a question whose reply came weeks later, or a member away for weeks with 20+ replies kept, still compares each reply time with the one seen time in both functions, so dot and tags agree; the Plus line after a gap of weeks between plans follows the 'renewal after it' rule in both Settings and the Plus screen.
